<b>Shardillards</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are flying creatures that disguise themselves as fossils.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Shardillards will start off disguised as a [[Shell Shards|Shell Shard]] cache, but once struck, they shake and unburrow from their position. This initial hit deals no damage to the Shardillard.

Shardillards fly and keep their distance from [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]], before curling into a ball and launching themselves at her. They ricochet off surfaces for around 2 seconds, shorter if Hornet is further away, until stopping. Shardillards have a short cooldown between attacks, where they simply fly and keep distance before launching themselves at Hornet again.

Shardillards deal {{Damage|1}} upon contact and with their attack.

Uniquely, a Shardillard holds {{S|30}} upon encounter. Every time it takes damage, {{S|3}} fly off it, with the 3 being subtracted from the amount dropped on death. The remaining amount dropped on death is subject to the [[Shell Shard]] bonus percentage and [[Shard Pendant]] bonus.
